subject: [RFC v2 0/1] mm: add source selector to memory.reclaim

reviews.author: Li Zhe
reviews.summary:
Reviewer Li Zhe noted that the patch does not distinguish between demotions and evictions, which is a problem since the existing behavior is preserved by this patch.

Reviewer noted that the patch's description of preserving existing behavior for reclaim was misleading, as it doesn't actually distinguish between demotions and evictions.

Reviewer Li Zhe noted that the patch description incorrectly implies a problem with not distinguishing between demotions and evictions, when in fact the patch preserves existing behavior.

Reviewer Li Zhe clarified the meaning of a percentage value in the test results, explaining it as the final deviation from a 50:50 target ratio, and committed to making the metric clearer in v3.

Reviewer Li Zhe noted that the patch does not distinguish between demotions and evictions, which was presented as a problem, but the existing behavior is preserved by this patch.

Reviewer Li Zhe noted that the patch description does not clearly distinguish between demotions and evictions, and requested clarification on this point.

Reviewer Li Zhe noted that the patch does not distinguish between demotions and evictions, which is a problem since the existing behavior is preserved in this patch.
reviews.raw_body:
Hi Joshua,

Thanks for the review and suggestions!

---

No, it does not. Thanks for pointing this out. It is indeed unnecessary
to mention it here.

---

Agreed. The patch only selects the reclaim source and otherwise preserves
the existing memory.reclaim behavior. I will make that clearer.

---

Yes, the percentage is the final deviation from the 50:50 target:

   max(abs(dram_ratio - 0.5), abs(cxl_ratio - 0.5))

I should have stated that directly. I will make the test metric clearer
in v3.

---

That makes sense. I will try to extend the tests to cover system-wide
pressure and multiple active cgroups in v3.

---

Agreed, and sorry for making this too long. I will make v3 much shorter
and drop the separate cover letter if it remains a single patch.

---

Thanks again for the review and suggestions!

Thanks,
Zhe

2026-11-13.patch_summary: This patch series aims to add a source selector to the memory.reclaim function, but it preserves the existing behavior for reclaim and does not distinguish between demotions and evictions as previously mentioned. The reviewer suggests that the commit message be shortened and provides feedback on test cases, specifically asking how the code handles multiple cgroups under system pressure and simultaneous presence on the host.
